description: Crags, boulders and their routes, with the terrain in relief and 3D. A crag lists its routes in the order of the rock with their grades; a route finds its crag. German by default.
highlights: A crag's routes left to right with grade, length and bolts
Add a route to a crag nearby, or start a new crag with it
The climbing fields of id-tagging-schema PR 2793
Terrain relief and a tilted 3D view (Mapterhorn, with a licence notice)
The relation column to order and check the routes
